title: CU-Brick Wins Merit Award at OSH Innovation and Technology Award 2026
titleZhHant: CU-Brick 獲頒 2026 年 OSH 創新及科技獎嘉許獎
summary: CU-Brick received the Merit Award in the Open Category of the OSH Innovation and Technology Award, recognising our effort to apply cable-driven robotics to brick-laying safety and productivity.
summaryZhHant: CU-Brick 在 職安健創科大獎 公開組獲得嘉許獎，肯定了我們把纜索驅動機械人應用於砌磚工序，以提升安全和效率的努力。

title: Won the 2nd Runner Up for YPEC 2025
titleZhHant: CU-Brick 在 YPEC 2025 獲得亞軍
summary: Our team won the 2nd Runner Up award in the Open Section of YPEC 2025 with CU-Brick, the brick-laying cable-driven robot for real-world construction.
summaryZhHant: 我們的團隊憑 CU-Brick 砌磚纜索驅動機械人在 YPEC 2025 公開組奪得亞軍。

title: Young Professionals Exhibition & Competition 2025
titleZhHant: 2025 年青年專業展覽及比賽
summary: We showcased CU-Brick at YPEC 2025 in City University of Hong Kong, connecting with industry leaders and fellow engineers.
summaryZhHant: 我們在香港城市大學舉行的 YPEC 2025 展示了 CU-Brick，並與業界領袖及同行工程師交流。

title: Presenting at CableCon2025 in Hong Kong
titleZhHant: 在香港 CableCon 2025 進行簡報
summary: We presented the CU-Brick paper at CableCon 2025 and shared how cable-driven robots are reshaping construction workflows.
summaryZhHant: 我們在 CableCon 2025 發表了 CU-Brick 論文，分享纜索驅動機械人如何重塑建築流程。
